---
title: "Optics Model Performance Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: readable
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
    fig_caption: true
params:
  object: null
  class_label: null
  remove_large_schools: false
  grouping_level: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                     fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6)
counts <- params$object@data
metrics <- params$object@metrics
group_vars <- params$object@group_vars
extra_groups <- setdiff(group_vars, c("category_name", "threshold"))
table_groups <- setdiff(group_vars, "category_name")
chosen <- setdiff(names(metrics), group_vars)
escape_html <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("'", "&#39;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  for (symbol in c("[", "]", "(", ")", "*", "_", "`", "\\", "#", "!", "|", "~")) {
    x <- gsub(symbol, paste0("&#", utf8ToInt(symbol), ";"), x, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  x
}
metric_labels <- c(
  tp = "True positives", fp = "False positives", fn = "False negatives",
  tn = "True negatives", precision = "Precision", recall = "Recall",
  f1 = "F1", fpr = "False positive rate", fnr = "False negative rate",
  accuracy = "Accuracy", false_positive_ratio = "False positive ratio",
  false_negative_ratio = "False negative ratio",
  total_actual_positives = "Total actual positives",
  total_actual_negatives = "Total actual negatives",
  agree = "Exact agreement", difference = "Count difference",
  relaxed = "Relaxed agreement"
)
goals <- c(precision = "max", recall = "max", f1 = "max", accuracy = "max",
           agree = "max", relaxed = "max", fpr = "min", fnr = "min",
           false_positive_ratio = "min", false_negative_ratio = "min",
           fp = "min", fn = "min")
optimal_metrics <- intersect(chosen, names(goals))
count_metrics <- intersect(chosen, c("agree", "difference", "relaxed"))
false_metrics <- c("tp", "fp", "fn", "tn")
show_table <- function(x) {
  cat(knitr::kable(x, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}
metric_plot <- function(metric) {
  plot_data <- metrics
  if (length(extra_groups)) {
    plot_data$.report_group <- do.call(
      interaction, c(lapply(plot_data[extra_groups], factor, exclude = NULL),
                     list(drop = TRUE, sep = " / "))
    )
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = threshold, y = .data[[metric]]))
  if (length(extra_groups)) {
    plot <- plot + ggplot2::aes(colour = .data[[".report_group"]],
                               group = .data[[".report_group"]]) +
      ggplot2::labs(colour = paste(extra_groups, collapse = " / "))
  }
  plot +
    ggplot2::geom_point() + ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Confidence threshold", y = metric_labels[[metric]]) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r introduction, results='asis'}
cat("\n# Introduction\n\n")
cat("<p>This report describes model performance against aligned reference counts for <strong>",
    escape_html(params$class_label), "</strong>, using <strong>",
    escape_html(params$grouping_level), "</strong>-level comparisons.</p>\n", sep = "")
cat("<p>Only explicitly calculated metrics are presented. Confidence thresholds refer ",
    "to the thresholds already aligned in the supplied object.</p>\n", sep = "")
if (length(extra_groups)) {
  cat("<p>Existing metadata groups are preserved: ",
      escape_html(paste(extra_groups, collapse = ", ")), ".</p>\n", sep = "")
}
cat("<p>", nrow(counts), " aligned count observations; ",
    length(unique(counts$threshold)), " thresholds represented in retained counts.</p>\n", sep = "")
if (params$remove_large_schools) {
  cat("<p>Large-school filtering is enabled: reference codes 299, 399, and 999 ",
      "were excluded. Only previously selected metrics were recalculated.</p>\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("<p>Large-school filtering is disabled. All reference and model counts ",
      "are retained unchanged, including codes 299, 399, and 999.</p>\n", sep = "")
}
if (!length(chosen)) cat("<p>No performance metrics have been calculated.</p>\n")
```

```{r optimal-confidence, eval=length(optimal_metrics) > 0, results='asis'}
cat("\n# Optimal Confidence\n\n")
cat("Best observed thresholds are shown separately for each selected metric and existing metadata group; ",
    "ties favor the highest confidence threshold. No weighted optimum is inferred.\n\n")
metric_groups <- if (length(extra_groups) && nrow(metrics)) {
  dplyr::group_split(dplyr::group_by(metrics, !!!rlang::syms(extra_groups)))
} else list(metrics)
best <- unlist(lapply(metric_groups, function(group) {
  lapply(optimal_metrics, function(metric) {
    values <- group[[metric]]
    usable <- is.finite(values)
    if (!any(usable)) return(NULL)
    optimum <- if (goals[[metric]] == "max") max(values[usable]) else min(values[usable])
    row <- data.frame(Metric = metric_labels[[metric]], Goal = goals[[metric]],
                      Threshold = max(group$threshold[usable & values == optimum]),
                      Value = optimum)
    if (length(extra_groups)) row <- cbind(group[1, extra_groups, drop = FALSE], row)
    row
  })
}), recursive = FALSE)
best <- Filter(Negate(is.null), best)
if (length(best)) show_table(do.call(rbind, best)) else cat("No finite metric values are available.\n\n")
```

```{r count-distribution, eval=length(count_metrics) > 0, results='asis'}
cat("\n# Count Distribution\n\n")
cat("Aligned model and reference counts are shown without recoding or capping.\n\n")
if (nrow(counts)) {
  distributions <- rbind(
    cbind(counts[, table_groups, drop = FALSE], count = counts$model_count, source = "Model"),
    cbind(counts[, table_groups, drop = FALSE], count = counts$truth_count, source = "Reference")
  )
  print(ggplot2::ggplot(distributions, ggplot2::aes(x = count, fill = source)) +
          ggplot2::geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) +
          ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(!!!rlang::syms(table_groups)), scales = "free_y") +
          ggplot2::labs(x = "Count", y = "Observations", fill = "Count source") +
          ggplot2::theme_minimal())
}
show_table(metrics[, c(table_groups, count_metrics), drop = FALSE])
```

```{r false-table, eval=all(false_metrics %in% chosen), results='asis'}
cat("\n# False Classification Table\n\n")
show_table(metrics[, c(table_groups, false_metrics), drop = FALSE])
```

```{r analysis, eval=length(chosen) > 0, results='asis'}
cat("\n# Analysis {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n")
for (metric in chosen) {
  cat("\n## ", metric_labels[[metric]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  show_table(metrics[, c(table_groups, metric), drop = FALSE])
  if (nrow(metrics) && any(is.finite(metrics[[metric]]))) print(metric_plot(metric))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
